name: A Night with Nadine
source:
After getting beaten to near-death after having one too many drinks at your local pub, you find yourself in a living house, with you being tended to by its owner: A potion-brewing bird by the name of Nadine. Now, you need to spend about 6 real-time minutes talking to her about stuff as she heals you up.

[From [url=https://indyboogaloo.itch.io/a-night-with-nadine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在当地的酒吧喝了太多酒后，你被打得几近死亡，然后你发现自己身处一所生活的房子里，你受到它的主人的照顾：一只名叫纳丁的酿造药水的鸟。现在，当她治愈你时，你需要花大约6分钟的实时时间与她谈论一些事情。

[来自[url=https://indyboogaloo.itch.io/a-night-with-nadine]Itch.io[/url]]
